# CLI Templates

These documents describe the accepted object model, supporting architecture,
implementation status, and package lifecycle contract for one Template Engine
in Azure Functions CLI. `func init` selects project templates and `func new`
selects item templates. Quickstarts are project templates, not a third
template kind.

- [Object model](Templates-EndToEnd-Object-Model-Review.md) — the six accepted
  responsibilities and intended command journeys.
- [Architecture](architecture.md) — current responsibility boundaries and
  command behavior.
- [Implementation](implementation.md) — implemented infrastructure,
  remaining work, and qualification status.
- [Packaging and acquisition](packaging-and-acquisition.md) — GA workload
  starter supply, Installed Templates registration, and deferred lifecycle
  capabilities.

Earlier designs and investigations are preserved in the
[archive](archive/).
